articles.summary: Ladder Capital Corp (NYSE: LADR) (“we,” “Ladder,” or the “Company”) will release its third quarter 2026 results on Friday, October 16, 2026 before the open of markets that day. The Company will host a conference call and webcast for investors at 10:00 a.m. Eastern Time that day to discuss the financial results. The conference call can be accessed by dialing (877) 407-4018 domestic or (201) 689-8471 international. Individuals who dial in will be asked to identify themselves and their affiliations. For those unable to participate, an audio replay will be available until midnight on Friday, October 30, 2026. To access the replay, please call (844) 512-2921 domestic or (412) 317-6671 international, access code 13763155. The conference call will also be webcast through a link on Ladder’s Investor Relations website at ir.laddercapital.com/event .
